description: Gatekeeper git TCB, submission and the deterministic Telegram decision path (PLAN.md items 8-11). Implements the single-source git commands (ossbot.common.gitcmd FORMAT_PATCH/NUMSTAT), the package.sh/unbundle.sh entrypoints exactly as DESIGN §9.11/§9.8/§9.13, gatekeeper package verification and artifact derivation from per-rev mirrors (§12.5, §12.5a, I6, I12) including round-5 NIT R5-N1 (bundle copied with O_NOFOLLOW into gatekeeper-private work dir), operator import (§9.13), submission with control_checkpoint before each write, identity check and dry-run 'would' payloads, read-only restart reconciliation, and the gatekeeper-owned Telegram front-end: update authorization (§14.2), opaque single-use message-bound callback tokens, Approve -> mode-stating Confirm two-tap, Reject, and the safety commands /status /pause /resume /kill /dryrun /help with a minimal escaped card (PLAN Decision 7). Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Item 8: verify DESIGN §23 item 19 on the distro's git 2.43 (git commit --trailer, interpret-trailers --parse, bundle create with a named ref, patch-id --stable, every FORMAT_PATCH/NUMSTAT flag, scoped protocol.file.allow=always last -c wins) and record in the ADR-0014 addendum; write src/ossbot/common/gitcmd.py, src/ossbot/sandbox_tools/numstat2json.py, sandbox/entrypoints/package.sh and unbundle.sh (--no-recurse-submodules on bundle fetches, R5-N1); tests/unit/entrypoints/test_unbundle_script.py runs the real scripts in fix_round and import modes.

Item 9: src/ossbot/gatekeeper/{gitops.py,derive.py,imports.py} and the /package, /package-ts, /import, /import-bundle handlers in api/contributions.py per §12.5 steps 1-8, §12.5a and §9.13. R5-N1: open /srv/ossbot/artifacts/<cid>/<rev>/change.bundle with O_NOFOLLOW, require S_ISREG and <= 50 MB, copy to /srv/ossbot/gatekeeper/work/<cid>-r<rev>.bundle (0600), sha256 the copy, run list-heads/verify/fetch only on the copy (paths injectable for tests). Tests: test_package_verify.py (every §22.1 case with production GIT_ENV/GIT_ARGS/BUNDLE_FETCH_ARGS, the real package.sh, plus 'directory at artifact path -> 422 bundle_invalid'), test_gitops_args.py, test_import.py, test_claim_live.py.

Item 10: github_writer.py (fork/push via GIT_ASKPASS fd helper/PR/comment; import-linter contract: only submit.py imports it), submit.py (immutable snapshot, binding recheck, GET /user login == profile.github_login else kill, X-OAuth-Scopes public_repo, control_checkpoint incl. R4-N2 dry-run mode check before steps 4-6, retries 2/8/30 s, 422 reconcile, interruption -> SUBMIT_FAILED interrupted, missing GITHUB_WRITE_TOKEN -> refused no_write_token per PLAN Decision 5), reconcile.py (§12.5 table, reads only), §12.6 live checks; telegram/{bot.py,auth.py,handlers.py,keyboards.py,escape.py,cards.py,commands/registry.py,commands/builtin.py} (python-telegram-bot 22.x, HTTPXRequest proxy http://10.212.0.2:3150, disabled when TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN absent or profile.telegram.user_id == 0); tests/fakes/fake_github.py (respx) and fake_telegram.py; tests test_submit.py (all M5/R4-N2 cases), test_live_checks.py, test_import_contracts.py, tests/telegram/test_handlers.py (approve->confirm happy path; foreign user, group chat, wrong message id, replayed, expired, killed, superseded), tests/telegram/test_escape.py (hypothesis).
Item 11: run the FEAT verification, set status completed, record findings (e.g. git version facts, any API shape decisions later FEATs reuse), commit locally.
acceptance_criteria: DEV pytest -m "unit or telegram" passes including test_real_package_script_bundle, test_bundle_fetch_needs_scoped_override, test_numstat_pinned, test_patch_compare_tolerates_git_version, test_patch_mismatch_rejected, test_hostile_git_config_ignored, the R5-N1 directory case, and every AC 15 rejection

test_submit.py proves: dry-run makes zero write calls (AC 4), kill/pause between push and PR stops further writes (AC 29), restart reconciliation issues only GETs, resume never submits, a mid-submission dry-run toggle stops the next write
test_handlers.py proves AC 7: foreign user, group chat, wrong message id, replayed or expired token -> no state change, logged at WARNING; Confirm text states LIVE or DRY RUN computed at that moment
lint-imports proves only gatekeeper.submit imports gatekeeper.github_writer; ruff, mypy strict and shellcheck (package.sh, unbundle.sh) clean

findings: VERIFIED 2026-10-17 (ADR-0014 addendum, live probe on the distro's git 2.43.0 = noble package, same as the sandbox-full base): commit --trailer works (no interpret-trailers fallback); interpret-trailers --parse prints the Signed-off-by line; bundle create refs/heads/ossbot-change ^base lists exactly that head with one '-<base>' prerequisite line (detached HEAD bundles list only HEAD); list-heads/verify work under protocol.file.allow=never, a bundle fetch needs the scoped -c protocol.file.allow=always placed last; every FORMAT_PATCH/NUMSTAT flag accepted (--no-signature drops the '-- 2.43.0' trailer; renames=false -> delete+add); patch-id --stable works on stdin outside a repo; R5-N1 confirmed (with 'always', fetching a directory path reads it as a local repo). GitHub fork API body {name, default_branch_only} verified on docs.github.com (ADR-0006 addendum); docs now default to API version 2026-03-10, the gatekeeper pins 2022-11-28 (re-check in FEAT-008). PENDING LIVE PROBE: GET /user + X-OAuth-Scopes and real fork/push/PR (needs GITHUB_WRITE_TOKEN); Telegram getMe/polling via HTTPXRequest(proxy=http://10.212.0.2:3150) only constructed, never connected (needs TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN + profile.telegram.user_id); doctor (FEAT-004) should report both as AWAITING SECRET. ENTRYPOINT INTERFACE for sandboxd (FEAT-003): sandbox/entrypoints/package.sh --round-base <sha> --package-ts <YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ> --name <n> --email <e> (reads /io/input/commit_message.txt, /work/repo; writes /io/output/{change.bundle,change.patch,diffstat.json,result.json}); unbundle.sh --mode fix_round|import --bundle-ref <ref> --checkout-sha <old_head_sha|base_sha> --rev <n> (input change.bundle resp. import.bundle). Both need OSSBOT_FORMAT_PATCH/OSSBOT_NUMSTAT in the env (bake from ossbot.common.gitcmd.FORMAT_PATCH/NUMSTAT; test_gitcmd_image_env.py), rsync and git in the image, numstat2json at /opt/ossbot/bin/numstat2json (= src/ossbot/sandbox_tools/numstat2json.py, stdlib, shebang python3); exit 3 + result.json {ok,error_class,head_sha} on failure; error classes bad_args, bad_env, base_missing, empty_change, bundle_refs, bundle_prereq_missing, bundle_invalid. OSSBOT_WORK/OSSBOT_IO/OSSBOT_PKG_ROOT/OSSBOT_NUMSTAT2JSON/OSSBOT_UNBUNDLE_HOME only relocate paths for tests. Two fixes beyond the DESIGN text: package.sh uses rsync --ignore-times (a same-size edit in the same second as the checkout was silently dropped by rsync's quick check; caught by a test), unbundle.sh fix_round uses checkout -f (the previous round's uncommitted edits block a plain checkout; reset --hard follows anyway). API SHAPES (FEAT-006 runner): POST /v1/contributions/{id}/package body = common.schemas.PackageRequest {rev, artifact_dir (must equal /srv/ossbot/artifacts/<cid>/<rev>), sha256s{change.bundle,change.patch,diffstat.json}, pr_title?, pr_body? (required for open_pr, ignored for push_update), claimed_head_sha, base_ref, base_sha, validation{}, review{}}; 200 {kind, action_id, approval_id, head_sha}; 202 {state_reason: awaiting_live_claim, action_id} (N5; re-call /package with the same rev after the claim is done); errors {error, detail}: 400 artifact_dir|title_body_required, 404, 409 not_packaging|stale_rev|claim_body_missing, 422 bundle_invalid|bundle_sha256|bundle_refs|base_mismatch|fabricated_base|multi_commit|parent_not_base|identity_mismatch(detail author|committer|signoff)|claimed_head_mismatch|branch_moved|patch_mismatch|patch_unreadable|policy(detail = comma codes), 423 paused/killed, 503 upstream_fetch_failed. Only patch_mismatch/patch_unreadable (FAILED + pause) and branch_moved (FAILED->WATCHING, watch_rounds=max) change state; every other 422 leaves PACKAGING and the runner decides (retry with a new rev or W-transition to FAILED). A changed change.patch/diffstat.json (sha256 differs from the request) counts as unreadable. Branch name ossbot/<issue|import>-<slug40>-<cid[-6:].lower()>. POST /v1/contributions/import (operator) -> 201 {cid} or 422 import_invalid:<not_a_target|repo_not_enabled|size|base64|sha256|not_a_bundle|upstream_fetch|heads|prerequisites|base_not_upstream|verify|fetch|head_not_descendant>; stores pr_title/pr_body (normalized) from the request; GET import-bundle -> application/octet-stream, 409 import_bundle_unavailable|import_bundle_corrupt. GATEKEEPER WIRING: AppContext gained gitops (GitOps: cache/<owner>__<repo>.git, mirrors/<key>/<cid>-r<rev>.git with alternates, work/<cid>-r<rev>.bundle 0600, derived/<cid>/<rev>/, imports/<cid>/), secret_scanner (None = gitleaks_scan: /usr/local/bin/gitleaks stdin, fails closed), create_approval(action_id, actor) (body_parts_total from telegram.cards.part_count; caller fires on_approval_created after commit) and reissue_cards(invalidated, actor) (now called by API dry-run toggle, config reload and /dryrun). build_context(gitops=...) defaults the ArtifactSource to derive.GitArtifacts (re-hash private bundle copy, re-derive patch/commit message from the per-rev mirror). gitops.RemoteFetch is injectable (production https_fetch via proxy; tests use tests/githarness.LocalRemote). housekeeping_once also runs packaging.prune_retention (terminal contributions lose mirrors). Submission: submit.Submitter / make_submitter(ctx, client, token); Submitter.preflight(approval_id) = Confirm-time live checks; reconcile.Reconciler + ReconcileService (start before Telegram, pending rows retried every 5 min, never touches in-flight rows); main.build_services; app.create_app(services=[...]) starts them in order in the lifespan. GitHub: github_read (GET only, GitHubReader, make_client(token, transport=...)), github_writer (fork/push/PR/comment, GitPusher with askpass at <githome>/askpass.sh reading the token from an inherited memfd, URL https://<login>@github.com/<fork>.git, credential.helper empty). live_checks.run(LiveInput, reader, conn, clock, limits) implements the §12.6 table incl. rate limits (ratelimit.check/used_in_window gained exclude_action_id so the executing action does not count against itself); 'other open PR' looks at the first 100 open PRs; CLAIM_RE lives in live_checks (FEAT-006 vetting should reuse it). TELEGRAM (FEAT-005 builds on): telegram/cards.py render(CardView)->CardMessages(card, parts) is the replaceable renderer (part i/K headers, <=3500 escaped chars per <pre> chunk), view_for_approval/view_for_action read DB only; keyboards (t:<22> callback data, card_rows = [Approve][Reject] only, confirm_rows, to_json); bot.CardPublisher queues card (dedupe card:<approval>), on_sent binds tg_message_id, queues parts (part:<approval>:<i>), mints tokens and edits the markup (arm:<approval>) only after every part was delivered; retry notes (retry:<action>) get a message-bound 'retry' token; OutboxWorker gained on_sent and batch (frontend uses batch=1 per 1 s); TelegramSender maps 429/BadRequest/network. handlers.Handlers(ctx, submit, preflight): auth -> token peek -> purposes approve/confirm/cancel/reject/retry + CONFIRMS (resume_confirm, dryrun_off_confirm); Approve refused while paused/killed with no state change; Confirm does check_token (read-only) + running + preflight before approvals.confirm, then submits in a background task (handlers.drain() in tests); non-command text is ignored (relay is FEAT-005). Reject: open_pr -> REJECTED, push_update -> WATCHING, claim -> SKIPPED/FAILED claim_rejected, comment -> action cancelled. Not built here (FEAT-005): reject reasons, request changes, edit title/body, view diff, logs, give-up-fix, stop-watching, /approve <cid> resend command, /queue etc. ApprovalService gained check_token, invalidate_one, rotate_card_tokens. commands.registry: @command(name, help=, safety=), @confirm_handler(purpose), Reply(text, Confirm(purpose,label,arg)), entry-point group ossbot.telegram_commands, menu() for setMyCommands. DEVIATIONS: push_update fork-tip re-check at submit and its reconciliation use GET /repos/<fork>/git/ref/heads/<branch> instead of a git fetch; a missing GITHUB_WRITE_TOKEN refuses before step 0 (approval invalidated no_write_token, action stays pending_approval, contribution unchanged); the phase-1 card shows no keyboard until delivered (no 'delivering' placeholder); ImportRequest.base_ref regex tightened to [A-Za-z0-9._/-]; import-linter unmatched ignore alerting switched to error; tests S107 ignored in pyproject. TESTS: 917 unit+telegram pass (tests/githarness.py GitWorld + LocalRemote, fixtures gctx/world/remote in tests/conftest.py, tests/fakes/fake_github.py respx FakeGitHub + FakePusher, tests/fakes/fake_telegram.py FakeBotRequest for a real PTB Application; tests/telegram/* auto-marked telegram).
